sloka: न नागा नापि गन्धर्वा नासुरा न मरुद्गणाः ।रामस्य समरे वेगं शक्ताः प्रतिसमाधितुम् ।। ५.३८.४४।।।।
transliteration: na nāgā nāpi gandharvā nāsurā na marudgaṇāḥ ।rāmasya samare vegaṁ śaktāḥ pratisamādhitum ।। 5.38.44।।।।

translations.english: (Now Sita turns to Hanuman and says) "In war serpents, gandharvas, demons or Marutas cannot withstand the speed of Rama's arrows and hit back.
